New to Higgsfield? Sign up through my link and get up to 50% off your first purchase 👉 https://higgsfield.ai/s/make-your-first-ai-video-yt-vndlgame-quORMl

I made my first AI video on Higgsfield AI with zero experience, and in this video I show you exactly how, step by step. No camera, no actors, no editing skills. I create a cowboy character with GPT Image 2.5, turn him into a character sheet so he looks the same in every shot, and bring him to life in a realistic 15-second AI video with Seedance 2.5. Then I change the whole scene with one prompt tweak and drop him into a trending video with Genjutsu.

If you've been wondering how to make AI videos but didn't know where to start, this is the AI video for beginners guide I wish I had. One AI video generator, every model in one place. Your turn!

⏱ Chapters
0:00 What can a beginner make with AI video today?

5:42 How do you put your character into a trend with Genjutsu?
6:10 How do you get 50% off your first purchase?

📝 My prompts

Character (GPT Image 2.5, 3:4):
Full body photo of a tough old cowboy, around 45, with a short grey beard and squinting grey-blue eyes. He's wearing a beat up dark cowboy hat, a long faded blue-grey duster coat with four faded red stars down the left sleeve, a dark red shirt, a rust colored scarf with brown leather fringe, dark pants, worn brown boots and an old leather gun belt with a revolver on his hip. He's standing straight and looking at the camera, face clearly visible under the hat. Plain light grey background, soft studio light, realistic photo.

Character sheet (GPT Image 2.5, 16:9):
Use the attached image and make a character sheet of this same cowboy in three panels: full body from the front, full body from the side, and a close up of his face. Keep everything exactly the same in all three, his face, beard, hat, coat with the red stars, red shirt, scarf and gun belt. Plain light grey background, even lighting, realistic photo, no text or labels.

Video (Seedance 2.5, 15s, 16:9, 720p):
@Image1 is my cowboy. He walks slowly toward the camera down the middle of a dusty old western town street at golden hour. The sun is low behind him, dust is floating in the light and his long coat is moving in the wind. Wooden saloons and shops on both sides. The camera starts low on his boots stepping in the dirt, then slowly rises and moves back in front of him. He stops, lifts his head and stares right into the camera from under his hat. Keep his face, hat and clothes exactly the same the whole time. One continuous shot. Sound: boots on dry dirt, wind, a creaky wooden sign and a bell far away. No music, no dialogue, no text on screen.

Prompt tweak (same settings): swap "at golden hour… moving in the wind." for "at night in a crazy dust storm. Oil lanterns are swinging on the porches throwing flickering orange light, and his long coat is whipping in the wind." and the sound line for "Sound: howling wind, sand hitting the wood, lanterns rattling."

💡 Tip: start with Plus (it's called Pro in some countries). It's the cheapest plan that includes Seedance 2.5, and you get a week of unlimited generations to experiment with.
